basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old living in the suburbs of Austin, Texas. I recently got into smart home technology after purchasing my first home. I work as a junior software developer at a local tech startup. In my free time, I'm either tinkering with my smart devices or browsing through tool reviews. I'm newly single and spend most of my evenings online, exploring new tech trends or watching DIY tutorials. I dislike overly technical jargon and prefer straightforward, practical solutions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have always been intrigued by technology. Most of my knowledge comes from hands-on experience and on-the-job learning. Recently, I've been diving into smart home systems, trying to make my place as automated as possible.
